When it is, interlacing of three-row Schur partitions gives each cubic mixed moment 1 and the unique pair of dual Pieri summands gives the purely holomorphic mixed moment 1. The exact fourth-moment polynomial follows by expansion. The phase function is increasing in \(\cos\theta\) on \([-1,1]\), and strict concavity of the positive-phase magnitude objective plus a reflection and one-inflection argument for the negative-phase objective yield unique sharp extrema. The quartic stationarity equations, asymptotics, and strict degree reversal follow algebraically. A separate exact integer Weyl-torus calculation verifies the six moment identities for \(1\le n\le9\); 3148 deterministic checker assertions passed. Finite checks are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The adjacent pair is the first unequal-degree dual symmetric-power packet on \(SU(3)\). Its exact two-sided norm and equality classification show the central charge not only changes the available fourth-moment invariants but forces opposite/aligning extremal phases in one residue class while preserving unrestricted phases in the others. The resulting \(O(1)\) asymptotic oscillation survives at arbitrarily high degree and yields a strict upper norm drop at every \(3k+1\) -> \(3k+2\) transition, an intrinsic obstruction to naïve degree monotonicity. The complete infinite classification and structural resonance have mathematical value beyond computing a narrow ad-hoc constant.
